projects.description: A showcase of my recent backend architectures and full-stack web applications.

fintech.title: FinTech Banking System
fintech.desc: Architected a full-stack financial application providing multi-currency account management and automated savings goals tracking.
fintech.details: Architected a full-stack financial application providing multi-currency account management and automated savings goals tracking. Engineered a secure payment flow integrating Stripe for real-time deposits, with robust backend transaction validations. Implemented 2FA, role-based access control (Admin/User), and a real-time notification system using WebSockets to ensure seamless user and admin experiences.

dental.title: Dental Clinic Management
dental.desc: A comprehensive management system for dental clinics. Built securely with robust authentication and structured patient records.
dental.details: A comprehensive management system for dental clinics. The backend ensures secure management of patient records, appointments, and billing. Implemented robust authentication to separate doctor, staff, and patient portals, ensuring data privacy and operational efficiency.

ecommerce.title: E-Commerce API
ecommerce.desc: A robust backend architecture for an E-commerce application built entirely using the NestJS framework.
ecommerce.details: This project is a robust backend architecture for an E-commerce application built entirely using the NestJS framework. The system provides comprehensive features including secure authentication (Google OAuth), electronic payment processing, email notifications, and cloud-based media storage.

store.title: Online Store Platform
store.desc: A full-stack e-commerce platform divided into customer frontend, admin dashboard, and backend server.
store.details: The project is a comprehensive full-stack e-commerce platform divided into three main modules: a customer-facing frontend, an admin dashboard, and a backend server. The system utilizes a modern, interactive UI for a seamless user experience, while securely handling data, user authentication, and payment processing on the backend via a robust RESTful API architecture.
